bio: Molly Favret is an Aesthetics Designer and member of the Media Team at Carolina Crown, and previously served as a Designer with the Crossmen Drum and Bugle Corps from 2014 to 2020. She began her color guard career at Pope High School earning two WGI World Championship medals, and performed with Crown Guard, Paramount World Winter Guard, and the Glassmen Drum and Bugle Corps. She runs her own creative design, graphics, and consultation business from Tarpon Springs, Florida.

Patrick Hinton is a brass educator who has served on The Cavaliers Brass Staff (fifth season as of the source). He previously worked with Spirit of Atlanta as Low Brass Coordinator and Brass Supervisor, and is now a consultant with their brass program. He also served on the brass staff of Atlanta CV and was a performing member with Spirit of Atlanta from 2002 to 2004.

Bobby Frey is a music educator based in Southern California who teaches at Sierra Vista Middle School and has a Bachelor's of Music from California State University Long Beach's Bob Cole Conservatory. He marched with Santa Clara Vanguard from 2005-2009, taught on Colts brass staff (2010-2011) and as Brass Caption Head (2012-2013), taught brass at Spirit of Atlanta (2014), joined Pacific Crest as Movement Instructor (2017), and has been on Phantom Regiment visual staff since 2022.

Adam Norris is a percussion specialist in the Louisville, Kentucky area, currently on the battery staff at The Cavaliers (2022–present) and Battery Coordinator for Rhythm X. He previously served as Assistant Battery Caption Head for the Blue Stars (2014–2018) and as Quad Tech for the Phantom Regiment (2011–2013).

Akira Torrijos has performed with drum corps Bluecoats, Mandarins, and Fever, as well as indoor lines Pulse Percussion, POW Percussion, and Freelancers. He has taught for Bluecoats, Pacific Crest, Carolina Crown, Pulse Percussion, POW Percussion, and Gold Indoor, and currently serves as a visual instructor for the Boston Crusaders. He has designed drill, choreography, and show concepts for Golden Empire, POW Percussion, Gold Indoor, Mira Costa High School, and Pacifica High School.

Andria Foerch is a color guard instructor who marched with Carolina Crown from 1996 to 2000 and has taught on the staffs of Carolina Crown, Santa Clara Vanguard, Phantom Regiment, Bluecoats, and Crossmen. She co-founded and directs Paramount Winterguard in the Atlanta area and has taught colorguard at numerous high schools and Georgia State University. She holds a Master of Arts in Teaching from Mercer University and works at Children's Healthcare of Atlanta.

Ben Carroll soloed with the Santa Clara Vanguard (2012–2014) and the Santa Clara Vanguard International Corps (2015). He was on instructional staff at the Blue Knights (2015–2017) and Phantom Regiment (2018–2020) before returning to teach brass at the Santa Clara Vanguard in 2022. He currently serves on the brass instructional staff for the Santa Clara Vanguard Drum and Bugle Corps.

Botello marched snare with Lone Star Drum and Bugle Corps from 1995 to 1997, aged out with Pioneer Drum Corps in 1999, and played snare in the Blue Knights WGI World Class Percussion Ensemble in 2000. He has been teaching drum corps since 2005 and has instructed Pioneer, Revolution, Blue Devils B, Colts, Mandarins, and Genesis. Botello holds a B.A. in Music Education from New Mexico Highlands University and teaches percussion at Bowie High School. He is the owner and creator of the Left Hand Path Drum Book series and is endorsed by Beetle Percussion, Mapex Marching, Salyers Percussion, and Sabian Cymbals.

Conrad Isenhour is a marching arts instructor, choreographer, visual designer, and adjudicator. He serves as Visual Caption Manager, Ensemble Manager, and choreographer for the Santa Clara Vanguard Drum & Bugle Corps, and has held visual and brass staff roles with The Crossmen, Boston Crusaders, Blue Stars, and The Cadets. He marched baritone for The Crossmen and Santa Clara Vanguard.

Geoff Longo marched with The Cavaliers Drum and Bugle Corps (2008–2010), spent three summers (2011–2013) on staff with The Mandarins as color guard caption head and visual designer, served in various staff roles with The Cavaliers (2014–2022), and is currently a color guard designer and lead choreographer for The Blue Knights. He also marched with Corona (2009) and The Pride of Cincinnati (2015).

Glen Crosby has been involved in the marching arts since 1980 and was a member of the Blue Devils from 1981 to 1984. He began instructing The Cadets in 1985 and worked with the Santa Clara Vanguard under Ralph Hardimon. He has served as Program Coordinator and Percussion Director for Pacific Crest Drum Corps and was percussion caption head for The Academy. He also spent 10 years with Pulse Percussion from 2009 to 2019.

Howard Weinstein is a music educator and drum corps leader who has served as corps director for the Boston Crusaders (1999–2007) and the Blue Stars (2009–2011), and as program coordinator for the Colts. He holds a degree in music education from the University of Central Florida, is a member of the Boston Crusaders Hall of Fame (inducted 2006), and served on the DCI Board of Directors, including as chairman in 2007.

Jake Lyons is a percussion instructor, performer, arranger, and administrator based in Tennessee. He was a percussionist for the Bluecoats Drum & Bugle Corps in 2012 and 2013, has served on the instructional staff for Spirit of Atlanta and the Colts Drum & Bugle Corps, and serves as a percussion instructor for the Bluecoats. He was the founder and CEO of Virtual Arts, Inc., the organization behind the Virtual Drum & Bugle Corps.

James Sparling earned a Music Education degree from Miami University with a minor in Architecture. He has served as percussion staff, arranger, and caption head for the Madison Scouts, Phantom Regiment, and the Cadets, among other ensembles. He was appointed Percussion Director of the Madison Scouts in 2015.

Jared Seymour is a middle school band and orchestra director residing in Southern California. He marched with Glassmen (2011) and Bluecoats (2013–2015) and has worked as a visual and music instructor for Jersey Surf, The Academy, Legends, and Pacific Crest. He holds a music education degree from Oakland University.

Jesse Backes is a percussion educator and arranger who has been on the percussion staff at Carolina Crown, Phantom Regiment (2014–2016 as battery visual instructor, snare technician, and battery coordinator), and The Cavaliers (2017–2022 as snareline instructor and battery coordinator). He performed with Colts Drum and Bugle Corps (2010) and The Cavaliers (2011–2013), where he earned the Fred Sanford High Percussion Trophy in 2011 and served as snare section leader and drum sergeant. He has also been battery coordinator and snare technician for Cavaliers Indoor Percussion and holds a Music Education degree from the University of Illinois (2013).

Dr. Lane Summerlin is a percussionist and educator who serves as Percussion Caption Manager for The Cavaliers and Front Ensemble Caption Head for Rhythm X. He has previously taught the Troopers, Colts, and Crossmen Drum and Bugle Corps, serving as Percussion Caption Head for both the Colts and Crossmen. He holds a Doctorate of Musical Arts from The Ohio State University, where his research focused on the history of the front ensemble in Drum Corps International.

Scott Simon is a percussionist who marched with Phantom Regiment Cadets beginning at age 13 and later with the Phantom Regiment in 2000, 2002, and 2003. He won the DCI Individual and Ensemble competition as a tenor drummer in 2002. He served on Phantom Regiment's percussion instructional staff for the 2008, 2009, and 2010 seasons, during which the corps earned two Fred Sanford Percussion Awards.

Sean Knuth is a percussion instructor currently teaching at La Canada High School and returning to the Phantom Regiment percussion staff. He also serves as battery manager for the Blue Stars Drum and Bugle Corps. He marched tenors with the Santa Clara Vanguard Cadets in 2008 and the Santa Clara Vanguard from 2009 to 2010, and has previously taught at the Academy Drum and Bugle Corps (2011), the Blue Knights Drum and Bugle Corps (2012–2013), and Pulse Percussion.

Steve Lyons is the Lead Mellophone Technician for the Colts and the Visual Designer for the Colt Cadets. He has been involved with drum corps as a performer, educator, and designer since 2001. He lives in Connecticut and works with high school and indoor programs as a designer and brass and visual instructor.

Zak Stillwell is a visual designer and instructor who performed with the Academy and Blue Devils, later instructing the Blue Devils A, B, and C corps. He served as visual caption head for the Blue Knights (2019–2022) and Mandarins (2023–2025), and his work with Blue Devils B helped the corps earn two Top 15 World Class finishes in 2014 and 2016. He has helped earn seven DCI World Championships as an instructor and performer, and studied music education and euphonium performance at the University of Arizona.

Alan Armstrong marched with Spirit of Atlanta from 1982 to 1986, serving as lead soprano, section leader, and soloist, then joined the brass staff from 1987 through 2001 in roles including caption head and arranging consultant. He later worked as brass caption head and arranger for Court of Honor, as an ensemble specialist for The Cavaliers, and as a consultant for Spirit of Atlanta when it reorganized in 2016.

Andy Grindle began his drum corps experience with the Madison Scouts in 2011 and returned as a Mellophone Instructor for the 2020 season. From 2012 to 2016 he served on the brass educational faculty of the Troopers, and in 2019 he was Brass Caption Manager of Genesis, helping lead them to their best finish in corps history. He is Director of Bands and Choirs at Kernan Middle School and Assistant Director of Bands at Sandalwood High School in Jacksonville, Florida.

Andrew Lynge was a member of the Phantom Regiment Drum and Bugle Corps from 2008 to 2009, winning the DCI championship and Fred E. Sanford High Percussion Award in 2008. He served on the percussion staff of Phantom Regiment from 2012 to 2014 and taught The Cavaliers Drum and Bugle Corps from 2016 to 2019.

Drew Shanefield is the brass designer, composer, and arranger for the Cadets Drum and Bugle Corps. He has served as brass caption head for the Cavaliers and Carolina Crown, brass arranger for the Crossmen, and program coordinator for the Bluecoats. He is an instrumental music teacher in the Haverford Township School District and a Yamaha Performing Artist.
Chris Johnston served on the visual staff of The Cadets, discussing video assignments in a DCI interview on FloMarching.

Curtis Uhlemann has served as a choreographer and designer for Drum Corps International ensembles including the ten-time world champions The Cadets, Phantom Regiment, and Santa Clara Vanguard. He is one of the original creators of ARCOS Dance and holds a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree, summa cum laude, in Modern Dance and Dance Science and Injury Prevention from Brockport College.

Dalia Berman is a percussionist and music educator in the Los Angeles area. She has been a front ensemble instructor at Pacific Crest Drum and Bugle Corps since 2014 and has marched with Mandarins, Phantom Regiment, The Academy, and other DCI and WGI groups. She holds a Bachelor's degree in Percussion Performance from California State University, Northridge and a Master's in World Percussion from California Institute of the Arts.

Dan Sailer is the Snare Instructor on the Phantom Regiment percussion design team. He is Professor of Percussion at Augustana University and Assistant Director of the Viking Marching Band. A former member of the Phantom Regiment snare line (2007–2010) and Santa Clara Vanguard (2011–2012), he has been a percussion staff member for the Boston Crusaders and Troopers Drum and Bugle Corps.

Ed Roush has served as a member of the brass educational staff at The Cavaliers, the Crossmen, and Santa Clara Vanguard. He has been a music educator for 34+ years in Colorado, Texas, Hawaii, and Indiana, and currently serves as Associate Director of Bands at Brownsburg High School.

Herbert Washington, originally from Charleston, South Carolina, graduated from Winthrop University with a BA in Dance Performance and Theatre and served as a Carolina Crown color guard performer (2006–2011) and lead guard in the 2011 "Rach Star" show, during which he smashed a real guitar at the World Championship Prelims. He later worked as a Carolina Crown color guard technician, designer, and choreographer (2012–2016) and joined the Boston Crusaders as Caption Head of Colorguard.

Jeremy Basso has been a brass instructor in Drum Corps International for over a decade. He currently serves on the brass staff of the Carolina Crown Drum and Bugle Corps and was named Co-Brass Caption Head of the Troopers in 2023, serving as their Brass Caption Head during the 2024 season. His previous DCI affiliations include the Mandarins, Crossmen, Blue Stars, and Southwind.

Lindsay Kusmierczak is the Guard Caption Head for the Bluecoats Drum & Bugle Corps and an alumna of the Phantom Regiment color guard (2002–2005) and winter guard (2007). She began marching drum corps with Southwind Drum and Bugle Corps (2000–2001) and has taught several drum corps including the Blue Knights, Glassmen, Southwind, and Millennium. She holds a Master of Science in Library and Information Science from the University of Illinois and a degree in fine arts with a minor in art history from Northern Illinois University.

Luke Vogt is a percussionist and educator who serves as the Audio Caption Head for the Santa Clara Vanguard Drum and Bugle Corps. He has performed with and instructed The Academy Drum and Bugle Corps. He holds degrees from Arizona State University and Texas Christian University and works as director of percussion for multiple schools in Fort Worth, Texas.

Marcus Neudigate was Front Ensemble Coordinator at Carolina Crown (2015–2019) and served on the percussion staff for the Sacramento Mandarins (2014–2016). He was a member of the Phantom Regiment Front Ensemble (2011–2012), becoming section leader in 2012. He currently works as a Creative Video Producer for the Bluecoats, and prior to that spent over 10 years teaching drumlines and touring with drum corps as an educator, arranger, and consultant.

Mike Hardiek began his drum corps career as Visual Caption Head for the Toledo Glassmen. He served as drill designer for the Crossmen from 2014 to 2016, later becoming their Member Experience Director and ultimately their Design Coordinator for 2026. He also served as director and visual designer for the Plan "B" Percussion Ensemble, a three-time WGI Percussion medalist.

Michael Tran marched with the Seattle Cascades and Troopers Drum & Bugle Corps as a lead trumpet player, served as Drum Major, and later returned as Executive and Corps Director, leading the corps to its highest DCI placement since 2010. He is in his tenth year as a middle school band director in the Pacific Northwest.

Noah Bellamy marched with the Cavaliers Drum and Bugle Corps in 1996 and later taught visual performance at Centerville High School. He has worked as a visual designer for The Troopers and Madison Scouts, and served on the visual team for the Crossmen in 2019. He also provided visual design for WGI finalists Infinity Percussion and Stryke Percussion.

Tommy Keenum is a Program Consultant for the Blue Knights Drum & Bugle Corps, coordinating visual and musical presentation and overseeing uniform, costume, and flag design. He performed in the rifle line of the 1983 Sky Ryders and with Odyssey Winterguard, and has designed shows for numerous corps including the Cadets, Santa Clara Vanguard, Phantom Regiment, Carolina Crown, and Blue Knights. He was inducted into the WGI Hall of Fame and is a singer-songwriter based in Nashville.

Adam Jatho is an Instructor at Crossmen Productions, the organization behind the Crossmen Drum & Bugle Corps based in San Antonio, Texas. He holds a Bachelor's Degree in Music Education from the University of Houston.

Amy Frost served on the brass staff of the Madison Scouts from 2010 to 2014 and was a brass instructor at the Blue Stars as a trumpet technician and Breathing Gym Specialist from 2008 to 2009. She marched soprano with Copper Star in 2001 and was a member of the Santa Clara Vanguard from 2003 to 2006, aging out as the 2006 I&E Trumpet Champion. She returned to the Vanguard as a member of the 2016 brass faculty. She holds a BM in Instrumental Music Education from Arizona State University.

Chris Schmitz is a full-time visual educator and designer based in Southern California who performed with the Sacramento Mandarins from 2016 to 2017. He served as a visual technician at Golden Empire Drum and Bugle Corps from 2018 to 2022 and joined the faculty of Gold Drum and Bugle Corps and Gold Indoor Percussion in 2022. He is currently on staff at Pacific Crest Drum and Bugle Corps and has served as visual caption head at Tesoro High School. He studies Dance Education at Fullerton College.

Daniel Galloway is Director of Bands at Clements High School in Sugar Land, Texas, where he has taught for 26 years. He has worked as a brass instructor with the Santa Clara Vanguard and Bluecoats Drum and Bugle Corps.

Eryn Boone is a color guard educator who has instructed the Boston Crusaders drum corps and served as Director of Carmel Color Guard. She previously performed with Carolina Crown and Pride of Cincinnati.

Hunter Dugie is a full-time visual designer, drill designer, and choreographer based in Austin, Texas, who studied Interpersonal Communication at the University of Texas at Austin. He marched with The Cavaliers Drum and Bugle Corps from 2014 to 2018, serving as Drum Major from 2016 until his age out in 2018. He has worked as a movement instructor for Pacific Crest and has designed for and taught organizations including The Guardians Drum and Bugle Corps, Vandegrift High School, and Westlake High School.

Jamey Thompson was hired as drill designer for Phantom Regiment, completing their design team, and was inducted into the Phantom Regiment Hall of Fame in 2025. He previously served as visual designer for the Madison Scouts (2003-2004) and the Glassmen (1997-2002), and was visual designer for the Empire Statesmen and Momentum winter percussion. He marched in the Cavaliers and the Cavaliers' winter guard.

Javier Cerna marched brass with the Santa Clara Vanguard from 2006 to 2010 and served as a drum major for the Vanguard Cadets in 2009. He was a member of the Santa Clara Vanguard Alumni Association Advisory Committee.

Joe Haworth is a pageantry arts professional and low brass musician who served as a brass staff member of the Blue Devils Drum & Bugle Corps for 15 years, including multiple years as brass caption head of the Blue Devils B Corps and brass caption head of the Blue Devils C Corps. He was an original cast member of the Broadway show 'Blast!', performing on trombone, euphonium, and percussion. He is also an adjunct faculty member at Bakersfield College in the Applied Music program.

Josh Brickey has been active in the marching arts since age 14, performing with Carolina Crown, the Bluecoats, Trinity Indoor Percussion Ensemble, and Rhythm X. He has served as Percussion Caption Head and battery arranger for The Cavaliers (sixth season) and as Percussion Caption Head for the Crossmen, and has worked with Rhythm X every season since 2007. He publishes educational materials through Plus 1 Designs and is partnered with Innovative Percussion, Zildjian, Evans Drumheads, and Pearl/Adams.
